senses.gloss: उद्-वंश mfn. of high decent, Hcat.
उद्-वंश m. N. of a Ṛṣi
उद्-वंश n. N. of a Sāman, TāṇḍyaBr.
उद्वंशीय n. N. of a Sāman.
उद्वंशीयोत्तर n. id., TāṇḍyaBr.
उद्-वक्त्र mfn. having the face up-lifted.
उद्-व॑त् त्, f. (fr. 1. उद्), height, elevation, RV.; AV. xii, 1, 2; Kauś.
उद्-व॑त् mfn. containing the word उद्, TāṇḍyaBr.
उद्-व॑त् (त्), n. N. of a Sāman, Lāṭy.
उद्-वत्सर॑ m. the last year of a cycle, MaitrS.; Kāṭh.; VarBṛS.
उद्वत्सरीय mfn. belonging to the above year, VarBṛS.
उद्-वादन n. the act of crying aloud, proclaiming, KātyŚr.; Vait.
उद्-वादन See उद्-√ वद्.
उद्-√ वध् P. (aor. Subj. -वधीत्) to tear to pieces, lacerate, RV. ii, 42, 2; VS. xiii, 16.
उद्-वन mfn. steep, precipitous, Kāṭh. (cf. प्रवण.)
1. उद्-वान n. the going out, being extinguished, Nyāyam.
2. उद्-वान mfn. (probably corrupted fr. उद्-वान्त), ejected, vomited, L.
उद्-वान n. the act of ejecting, vomiting, L.
a stove, L.
उद्-वपन n. the act of pouring out, shaking out
उद्-वापन n. the act of putting out (the fire) Comm. on ĀpŚr.
उद्-वपनी f. See पिष्टोद्˚.
उद्-वाप m. the act of throwing out, removing Comm. on Nyāyam.
ejection, KātyŚr.; Kauś.
(in logic) nonexistence of a consequent resulting from the absence of an antecedent, W.

उद्-√ वम् P. -वमति, to vomit out, spit out;
to give out, emit, shed (tears), throw (arrows, glances &c.), TS.; MBh.; Ragh. &c.
उद्-वमन n. the act of giving out, emitting, shedding (e.g. tears), Pāṇ. iii, 1, 16.
उद्-वमित mfn. vomited, ejected, L.
उद्-वान्त mfn. id.
उद्-वान्त m. an elephant out of rut, L.
उद्-वान्ति f. the act of giving out, emitting, Vop.
उद्-वामिन् mfn. ifc. vomiting out, Car.
उ॑द्-वयस् mfn. one by whom corn is produced or ripened [Mahīdh.], VS. ix, 3.
उद्-वर्ग See उद्-√ वृज्.
उद्-वर्ग m. one who roots up, a destroyer, KauṣUp. ii, 7.
उद्-वर्त &c. See उद्-√ वृत्.
उद्-वर्त mfn. superfluous, redundant, plentiful
left over as a remainder, L.
उद्-वर्त m. a remainder, surplus, L.
उद्-वर्त्मन् n. a wrong road, MaitrUp. vi, 30.
उद्-वर्धन See उद्-√ वृध्.
उद्-वर्धन n. sly or suppressed laughter, L.
उद्-√ वाश् Ā. -वाश्यते, to address in a weeping voice or while uttering lamentations, Bhaṭṭ. iii, 32.
1. उद्-वास m. (for 2. See s.v.) banishment, exile
abandonment
setting free, dismission g. बलादि, Pāṇ. v, 2, 136; BhP.
carrying out for slaughter, killing, L.
2. उद्-वास mf(आ)n. (for 1. See उद्-√ 5. वस्) one who has put off clothes (said of a woman who has put off her soiled clothes after her period of impurity), Kauś.
उद्-वस mfn. (cf. दुर्-वस) uninhabited, empty, Rājat.
disappeared, gone, Viddh.
उद्-वस n. solitude, Śatr.
उद्-वास—वत् mfn., Pāṇ. v, 2, 136.
उद्-वासन n. the act of taking out or away (from the fire), KātyŚr.; Kauś.
quitting, abandoning
expelling, banishing
taking out in order to kill, killing, slaughter, L.
उद्-वासनीय mfn. to be taken away or removed, Vas.
उद्वासिन् mfn. g. बलादि, Pāṇ. v, 2, 136.
उद्वासी-कारिन् mfn. making (a country) inhabited, TBr. i, 2, 6, 7.
उद्-वा॑स्य mfn. to be taken off, MaitrS.
to be put away, BhP.
relating to the killing of a sacrificial animal, R.
उद्-वस्त्र mfn. throwing off clothes, Suśr.
उद्-वह॑ mfn. carrying or leading up, AV. xix, 25, 1
carrying away, taking up or away, ŚBr.; Pāṇ.
continuing, propagating, MBh.; R.; Kathās.
eminent, superior, best, L.
उद्-वह॑ (अस्), m. the act of leading home (a bride), marriage, BhP.
son, offspring, MBh.; R.; Ragh.
chief offspring, Ragh. ix, 9
the fourth of the seven winds or courses of air (viz. that which supports the Nakṣatras or lunar constellations and causes their revolution), Hariv.
the vital air that conveys nourishment upwards
one of the seven tongues of fire
N. of a king, MBh.
उद्-वहा (आ), f. daughter, L.
उद्-वाह m. the act of leading home (a bride), marriage, wedding, MBh.; Kathās.; VarBṛS. &c.
उद्-वहन n. the act of lifting or bringing up, Suśr.; Ragh.
carrying, drawing, driving
being carried on, riding (inst.), Pañcat.; Ragh.; Kum.; Mn. &c.
leading home (a bride), wedding, marriage, PārGṛ.; BhP.
possessing, showing, Rājat.
the lowest part of a pillar, pediment Comm. on VarBṛS.
उद्-वाहन mf(ई)n. drawing up, lifting up, L.
उद्-वाहन n. anything which raises or draws up, L.
ploughing a field twice, L.
anxiety, anxious regret, L.
marriage, L.
उद्-वाह—कर्मन् n. the marriage ceremony, Mn. iii, 43.
उद्-वाह—तत्त्व n. N. of wk. of Raghu-nandana on marriage ceremonies.
उद्-वाह-मङ्गल n. a marriage-feast, Mālatīm.
उद्वाहर्क्ष n. (˚अ + ऋ˚) ‘marriage Nakṣatra’, one held to be auspicious for a marriage, BhP. x, 53, 4.
उद्-वाहनी (ई), f. a cord, rope, L.
उद्वाहिक mfn. relating to a marriage, matrimonial, Mn. ix, 65.
उद्-वाहित mfn. raised, lifted or pulled up, eradicated.
उद्वाहिन् mfn. one who raises or draws up, L.
one who marries, relating to marriage, L.
उद्वाहिनी f. a rope, L.
उद्वोढु-काम mfn. desirous of marrying.
उद्-वोढृ m. a husband, T. (quoted from the Mahā-nirṇaya-tantra).
उद्-वोढृ See col. 1.
उद्-वह्नि mfn. emitting sparks or gleams (as an eye), Śiś. iv, 28.
उद्-वह्नि—ज्वाल mfn. sending flames upwards, shining upwards, Kathās. cxviii, 76.
उद्-√ वा P. -वाति, to be blown out, go out, AitBr. viii, 28, 10; Kauś. (cf. उद्-√ वै.)
उद्-वा॑चन mfn. causing to cry out (?), AV. v, 8, 8.
उ॑द्-वार mfn. (fr. 1. वर = वाल), having the tail raised, TS. i, 8, 9, 2; TBr. i, 7, 3, 6.
उद्वा॑ल-वत् m. N. of a Gandharva, ŚBr. xi, 2, 3, 9 Comm. on VS.
उद्-वाष्प mfn. shedding tears, Kathās.
उद्-वाष्प—त्व n. the act of shedding tears, Vikr. 29.
उद्-वासस् mfn. id., ŚBr.
उद्-विकासिन् mfn. (√ कस्), blown, expanded, open, Kād.

उद्-वि-√ घुष् Caus. P. -घोषयति, to cause to sound loud;
to declare or proclaim aloud, BhP.
उद्-वि-√ चक्ष् Ā. -चष्टे, to perceive, BhP. xi, 23, 44.
उद्-√ वीज् Pass. -वीज्यते, to be blown upon or against, MBh. iii, 1757.
उद्-विग्न mfn. shuddering, starting, frightened, terrified, MBh.; R.; Suśr.; Ragh. &c.
sorrowful, anxious, grieving for (an absent lover), MBh.; Daś.; Bhag. &c.

उद्-विग्न—चित्त, उद्-विग्न—चेतस्, उद्-विग्न—मनस् or उद्-विग्न—हृदय, mfn. having the mind or soul agitated by fright, depressed in mind;
 sorrowful, anxious, distressed, MBh.; BhP.; MārkP. &c.

उद्-विग्न—चित्त, उद्-विग्न—चेतस्, उद्-विग्न—मनस् or उद्-विग्न—हृदय, mfn. having the mind or soul agitated by fright, depressed in mind;
 sorrowful, anxious, distressed, MBh.; BhP.; MārkP. &c.

उद्-विग्न—चित्त, उद्-विग्न—चेतस्, उद्-विग्न—मनस् or उद्-विग्न—हृदय, mfn. having the mind or soul agitated by fright, depressed in mind;

उद्-विग्न—चित्त, उद्-विग्न—चेतस्, उद्-विग्न—मनस् or उद्-विग्न—हृदय, mfn. having the mind or soul agitated by fright, depressed in mind;
 sorrowful, anxious, distressed, MBh.; BhP.; MārkP. &c.

उद्-विग्न—दृश्, f. and उद्-विग्न—लोचन, n. a frightened glance;
 mfn. one who looks frightened, BhP.

उद्-विग्न—दृश्, f. and उद्-विग्न—लोचन, n. a frightened glance;
 mfn. one who looks frightened, BhP.
उद्-वेग mfn. going swiftly
an express messenger, a runner, courier, &c., L.
steady, composed, tranquil, L.
ascending mounting, going up or upwards, L.
an ascetic whose arms by long habit continue always raised above the head, L.
absence of passion or emotion, L.
उद्-वेग m. trembling, waving, shaking
agitation, anxiety
regret, fear, distress (occasioned by separation from a beloved object), MBh.; Ragh.; Pañcat. &c.
the being offended, Kāvyād.
admiration, astonishment, L.
(उद्वेगं√ कृ, to disturb; to be disturbed in mind, R.; Sāh.; Pañcat. &c.)
उद्-वेग n. the fruit of the Areca Faufel
the Areca nut (called betel nut because eaten with the betel leaf), L.
उद्-वेग उद्-वेजक, &c. See cols. 1 & 2.
उद्-वेग—कर mfn. causing anxiety or agitation or distress, Pañcat.
उद्-वेग—कर्तरी f. an Areca nutcracker, L.
उद्-वेग—कारक mfn. causing anxiety or agitation or distress, Pañcat.
उद्-वेग—कारिन् mfn. causing anxiety or agitation or distress, Pañcat.
उद्-वेग—वाहिन् mfn. bringing or causing agitation, disquieting, troubling, Kathās.
उद्वेगिन् mfn. suffering distress, anxious, unhappy, L.
causing anxiety or agitation of mind, Pañcat.
उद्-वेजक mfn. agitating, distressing, annoying, causing pain or sorrow, Śārṅg.
उद्-वेजन mfn. id., Kathās.; Kām.
उद्-वेजन n. shudder, shuddering, Suśr.
agitation, fear
the act of terrifying, causing to shudder, Daśar.; Sāh.
उद्-वेजन—कर mfn. causing to shake with horror, causing excitement or pain, Mn.
उद्-वेजनीय mfn. to be feared
to be shrunk from, MBh.; R.; Pañcat.; Suśr.
उद्-वेजयितृ mfn. terrifying
a terrifier, MW.
उद्-वेजित mfn. caused to shudder
grieved, pained, afflicted.
उद्-वेजिन् mfn. causing anxiety or agitation of mind, causing shudder or horror, Kathās.
उद्-वि-√ दॄ Caus. P. -दारयति, to dig up, turn or tear up, BhP. x, 68, 71.
उद्-विद्ध mfn. See उद्-√ व्यध्.
उद्-विद्ध mfn. tossed upwards, high, elevated, MBh.; R.
उद्-विवर्हण n. (√ वृह्), the act of plucking out, tearing out, BhP.
उद्-वि-√ सृज् P. -सृजति, to leave, abandon, BhP. iv, 31, 22.
उद्-वीक्षण n. the act of looking up or upwards
look, view, MBh.; Ragh.
उद्-वीक्षित mfn. looked at
perceived, MBh.; Ragh.
उद्-वीक्ष्य ind.p. having looked upwards &c.
उ॑द्-वीत mfn. (√ 1. वी) driven out, expelled, AV.
उद्-√ वृ

उद्-√ वृ Ā. (Impv. 2. sg. -वरस्व) to elect, select, choose, R. (ed. Schlegel), ii, 11, 9;
 (v.l. -धरस्व ed. Bombay.)
उद्-वृत्य ind.p. having opened, opening wide (the eyes), MBh.
उद्-वृत्य mfn. turning round or about, BhP. x, 13, 56.
उद्-वृंहण See उद्-बृंहण.

उद्-√ वृज् P. (Impv. 2. sg. -वृङ्ग्धि) to tear out, pluck out, root up (figuratively), KauṣUp. ii, 7 :
Intens. (p. -व॑रीवृजत्) to stretch out, extend, RV. vi, 58, 2.
उद्-वर्तक mfn. causing to rise, increasing, MW.
(ifc.) rubbing, Pāṇ.
उद्-वर्तक m. (in math.) the quantity assumed for the purpose of an operation.
उद्-वर्तन mfn. causing to burst, Hariv. 9563
उद्-वर्तन n. the act of rising, going up, ascending, jumping up, Megh.; Kathās.; VarBṛS.
the springing up of plants or grain &c.
swelling up, overflowing, Car.
drawing out metal, laminating, W.
grinding, pounding
rubbing or kneading the body, rubbing and cleansing it with fragrant unguents
the unguents used for that purpose (or to relieve pains in the limbs &c.), Yājñ.; Mn.; Suśr.; Kathās. &c.
bad behaviour, bad conduct, L.
उद्-वर्तित mfn. caused to come out or swell up, Kathās. xxix, 80
raised, elevated, Suśr.
perfumed, scented, rubbed, kneaded, shampooed, Pañcat.; Subh.
उद्-वर्तिन् mfn. ifc. rubbing or kneading with.
उद्-वृत्त mfn. swollen up, swelling
prominent, Suśr.; MBh.; Hariv.; Bhartṛ.
excited, agitated, waving, MBh.; Ragh.; BhP.; Suśr. &c.
extravagant, ill-behaved, ill-mannered, proud, arrogant, MBh.; R.; Rājat. &c.
turned up
opened, opened wide (as eyes), MBh. vii, 5405; ix, 432; MārkP. xiv, 62 (erroneous for उद्-वृत, BRD.)
उद्-वृत्त m. a particular position of the hands in dancing
उद्-वृत्त n. (in astron.) the east and west hour circle or six o'clock line (cf. उन्-मण्डल).
उद्-√ वृध् See उद्-वृद्ध below.
उद्-वृद्ध mfn. grown up, come forth, appearing, Rājat. i, 252.
उद्-√ वृष् Ā. (Impv. 2. sg. -वावृषस्व, RV. viii, 50, 7; p. -वावृषाण॑, RV. iv, 20, 7; 29, 3) to pour out, distribute plentifully.
उद्-वृषभ-यज्ञ m. a particular sacrifice Comm. on Jaim. Comm. on Nyāyam.

उद्-√ वृह् P. -वृहति, to draw up, pull out by the roots, eradicate, RV. iii, 30, 17; vi, 48, 17; TS.; ŚBr.; KātyŚr.; MBh.;
to draw out (e.g. a sword from the scabbard), MBh.; Bhaṭṭ.
उद्-वृढ mfn. drawn or pulled out, eradicated, KātyŚr.
उद्-√ वे P. -वयति, to weave or fasten to or up, AitBr. iv, 19, 3; TBr. i, 2, 4, 2.
उद्-वेचम् ind. picking out, Gobh.
उद्-वेदि mfn. furnished with an elevated altar, Ragh. xvii, 9.

उद्-√ वेप् Ā. -वेपते, to tremble, be agitated or frightened, AV. v, 21, 2; TBr.; Kāṭh.; MBh. :
Caus. P. -वेप॑यति, to cause to tremble, agitate, frighten, AV.
उद्-वेप m. the act of trembling, agitation, T.
उद्-वेप mfn. trembling, agitated, T.
g. संकलादि, Pāṇ. iv, 2, 75 (not in the Kāś.)
उद्-वेपिन् mfn. trembling, R. (B.)
उद्-वेल mfn. running over the brim or bank, overflowing, Kathās.; BhP.; Ragh.; AgP.
excessive, extraordinary, Kād.
loosened, free from, Prasannar.
उद्वेलय Nom. P. उद्वेलयति, to cause to run over or overflow, Prasannar.
उद्वेलित mfn. caused to overflow, Hcat.
उद्-वेल्लित mfn. tossed up, elevated, high, Kathās.

उद्-√ वेल्ल् P. -वेल्लति, to toss up;
to raise one's self, rise, Mālatīm. 140, 3; Kathās. lix, 42.
उद्-वेल्लन n. rolling, Dharmaś.
उद्-वेष्ट mfn. investing, enveloping, surrounding, L.
उद्-वेष्ट m. the act of surrounding, enclosing, tying together, Car.
investing a town, besieging or surrounding it, W.
1. उद्-वेष्टन n. (for 2. See s.v.) the act of surrounding, wrapping, tying together
contraction
convulsion (of the heart), straitening
pain in the back of the body, Suśr.
(also) relieving a besieged town, HPariś.
2. उद्-वेष्टन mfn. freed from bonds or ties, unbound, unfettered, Ragh.; Kum.
उद्-वेष्टनीय mfn. to be unbound or unfastened, Megh. 95.
उद्-वेष्टित mfn. surrounded, invested, enclosed.

उद्-√ वै P. -वा॑यति (aor. -अवासीत्, ŚBr. x, 3, 3, 8) to become weak or languish, faint, be extinguished, go out (as fire), die, TS.; TBr.; ŚBr.; ChUp. :
Caus. -वा॑पयति, to cause to extinguish or go out, TBr. i, 4, 4, 7.
उद्-√ व्यध्
उद्-व्य्-उद्-√ 2. अस् P. -अस्यति, to give up wholly or completely, BhP. iv, 7, 44.
उद्-व्यूढ mfn. dropped from (comp.), Śak. (v.l.).

उद्-√ व्रज् P. -व्रजति, to go away or out of (the house) ;
to leave, abandon (one's house), TāṇḍyaBr.; ChUp.
